verdict.rationale: Token2 makes FIDO2/PIV security keys and the companion tools to manage them, such as the desktop and mobile apps, fido2-manage, and the bulk-enrollment scripts. It has no user-authored automation product, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. The bulk Entra ID enrollment script and the headless key-insertion watcher are fixed utilities, not user automations with version history, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
